user.title: DHL Shipment Tracking
user.description: Configure DHL parcel tracking. Account connection is completely optional — you can track packages without an account by entering tracking numbers directly.

account_token.title: DHL Account — Session / Refresh Token (Recommended)
account_token.description:
Enter your DHL session/refresh token (`dhlr0` or `dhla0`).

How to get your token:
1. Log in to your DHL customer account at dhl.de in your browser.
2. Open Developer Tools (F12) > Application > Storage > Cookies > `https://www.dhl.de`.
3. Click on the cookie named `dhlr0` (DHL refresh token) or `dhla0` (DHL access token).
4. Copy the entire Value string (starts with `eyJ...`) and paste it here.

account_web.title: DHL Account — Web Auth Code
account_web.description:
Enter the authorization code obtained from completing the DHL Web login dialog.

How to obtain your code:
1. Open the DHL authorization URL in your browser.
2. Complete login and 2FA verification.
3. Copy the authorization `code` parameter from the redirected URL in your browser address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DHL Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your DHL session token (`dhlr0` or `dhla0`) has expired. Please copy a fresh cookie value from dhl.de (DevTools > Application > Cookies) to resume tracking.

init.title: DHL Options
init.description:
Adjust account connection, tracking numbers, or polling interval.

Tip: For account connection, enter the cookie value of `dhlr0` (refresh token) or `dhla0` from dhl.de Cookies (F12).
